title: Nth Fibonacci Number Modulo
description: The Fibonacci sequence is defined by `F(0) = 0`, `F(1) = 1`, and `F(n) = F(n - 1) + F(n - 2)` for `n >= 2`. Given a non-negative integer `n` up to `10^15`, return `F(n) mod (10^9 + 7)` in `O(log n)` time.
hints: Express the recurrence as a 2x2 matrix power `[[1, 1], [1, 0]]^n`, or use the fast doubling identities `F(2k) = F(k) * (2*F(k + 1) - F(k))` and `F(2k + 1) = F(k)^2 + F(k + 1)^2`.
Keep intermediate values modulo `10^9 + 7` using 64-bit integers and handle subtraction cleanly so remainders stay non-negative.
